Destructive button

Solid and readable, always a verb, an icon where it helps. Never a pale tinted ghost.

Solid (default for confirmed, high-impact deletes)

Neutral destructive (low risk, toolbars, undoable)

Danger colour on text and icon only. No tinted fill. If the action can be undone with a toast, prefer the neutral button.

Hierarchy: one destructive action per view, never beside Primary

Do: neutral next to destructive
Do not: primary next to destructive

In a menu: text colour plus icon, last, after a separator
